{07 0f 00}I lost?{01 00 00 0a 00} How is that even
possible, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}And I lost to {04 1f 00}
of all people? That's just
sad.

{07 0f 00}Ma kaotasin?{01 00 00 0a 00} Kuidas see
üldse võimalik on, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?

{07 16 00}Ja just {04 1f 00}
mind võitis? See on lihtsalt
kurb.

{07 02 00}Whoa, whoa, whoa,
{01 00 00 14 00}{04 1f 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}You actually
beat me?!
{07 06 00}So I slacked off a little,{01 00 00 05 00}
but you caught that way
too fast, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

{07 02 00}Oot, oot, oot,
{01 00 00 14 00}{04 1f 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}Sa tõesti
võitsid mind?!
{07 06 00}Ma looderdasin veidi,{01 00 00 05 00}
